rust_tests.reason: A's group producer for DELETE roots (dev3-row-delete.md#implementation-2b2): it dispatches on the RootJob's effect byte; the delete RowReserve's sealed old row (RowProducerInput::Delete: cell C and record projection) goes to a DELETE root, an INSERT value to an INSERT root, and a CLR compensates either. DeleteForward replaces the committed, pruned row with the actor's tombstone and makes U Live with the old value (432+L, header in the U buffer, value written straight into the after page); DeleteClr restores the row from U's Live before read through the table schema (entry (a)) and leaves U Releasing with no value; the H proof reads a DELETE predecessor's Live U by its outline (entry (b)); the leaf inspect takes, beside Inline rows, a tombstone stamped Transaction with its U (any transaction's) and refuses any other as Unsupported. RDL-A: A's five history D groups (three DeleteForwards, the DeleteClr and the INSERT Forward over an effect-1 H) are byte-equal to the independent literals of tests/fixtures/module-row-format/transition-delete, and A refuses an INSERT value on a delete root, another sealed projection or cell, a sealed old row on an INSERT root and a DeleteClr over an uncommitted RowValue before, all ahead of any output. The MCA00-V06 INSERT literal, refusal and C-observer cases keep the INSERT groups unchanged.

A's DELETE statement and entries: delete_statement drives C's preflight_delete and reserve_delete through the INSERT row steps (flush retry, finish on a refused Reserve, Cancel after the Reserve) and answers 0 or 1 rows; autocommit_delete_live and transaction_delete_live reuse the executor's statement frames through StatementRows. jobs.rs observes DELETE roots: DeleteForward/DeleteClr/DeletePrune follow the INSERT role's Job rules with the root's effect byte bound to the opcode, a Reserve's after effect must be the plan's, and Clr/Prune keep the effect byte; the N1 cross-check runs jobs.rs over every history D group (RDL-J job observer). transition.rs: the DELETE Change arms (ReserveDelete, DeleteForward, DeleteClr, DeletePrune) lose their 2b-1 dead_code allowances now that product code constructs them, and C exposes row_projection (the XRP1 projection a delete RowReserve draft seals), leaf_reservation (D over a Jobs bank, for INSERT Reserve's Capacity) and the counted source bounds of both and of the typed row record for the C censuses; transition_delete_tests.rs shares history D's actor, befores and leaves with A's RDL-A literal cases. The scope3 Undo/leaf observers (semantic_row/{undo,leaf}.rs, test-only oracles with no product caller) stay skipped for effect-1 actors in the N1 cross-check and status.rs skips the DELETE opcodes; their DELETE comparison is the next PR (dev3-row-delete.md#implementation-2b2). The RDL-C history D cases and the N1/S1A/S1D/S1G cases pin C's DELETE and INSERT groups unchanged.

C's DELETE write path (dev3-row-delete.md#classification, #api): preflight_delete classifies the target under the statement snapshot (row_delete_snapshot) before any Free Undo selection (target_class: the table schema, then a table with any Index record is Unsupported ahead of the class by the same conservative count INSERT uses, then delete_class) and answers NoRow after the WAL prefix recheck and the Catalog/table read records; the cut keeps the classified RowId (RowPreflightCut.delete); reserve_delete reserves a DeletePlan against the XRP1 projection of the old record, and the Forward/CLR steps select DeleteForward/DeleteClr by the root Job's effect (RowControlObservation names it). INSERT Reserve's Capacity now also keeps the leaf reservation D of the table's Retained DELETE roots. The disk/disk_api/plan4_apply re-exports add RowDeleteStep and RowValueBefore. B reads a DELETE tombstone (dev3-row-delete.md#read): C's capture takes a tombstone (always Transaction(T) with its U) beside Inline rows and the candidate says it is deleted; the new C value_before reads the tombstone's U through entry (a) with the operation's Catalog schema in missing_before's LOCATION/LOAD order, judges the U's shape in tombstone_before (the tombstone's own transaction, Status generation and mutation under a Transaction stamp, a RowValue Committed(q_old) Inline before; anything else or a Releasing U is Fatal), puts the old canonical in the copy buffer and returns row, q_old and logical; copy_before copies it once B has judged q_old <= S. B: own T, or T committed at q_T <= S, reads no row; otherwise the old value when q_old <= S. RDL-B01..B05 over C0 literal tombstone cells (tests/fixtures/module-row-read/make_delete_cells.py), the tombstone_before unit cases (the one accepted shape, ten refused U edits and three refused tombstone stamps: another transaction, another Status generation, Committed), RDL-J03 over the actual C supply, and RDL-B07..B09 over it: one edit of a resident page under an explicit transaction's DELETE makes the next statement's point read Fatal with the system fenced and no output (a Releasing U: Census/Undo; a Committed tombstone with no U: capture's Source/Invariant; a Missing U under the tombstone: tombstone_before's Census/Invariant), and two controls that re-encode the same cells through each edit path read the old value 100. The other half of the contract's B09 (a RowValue U under an Inline Transaction row) stays read_missing's Unchanged Unsupported (MCB04-V14, consumers F02), recorded in section 17. The read census S5R-C01/C02 gains value_before's load/location phases (C and B caller terms), every phase within the unchanged 34,586 B (largest value_before phase 34,460 B); the MCB00 driver cases keep the INSERT-era reads unchanged.
